Package io.webagent4j.crawler.api

Record Class CrawlFailure

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.webagent4j.crawler.api.CrawlFailure
Record Components:
requestedUrl - the URL the fetch attempt started from (a seed, or a discovered link's normalized identity)
failedUrl - the URL actually being fetched at the moment of failure - equal to requestedUrl unless one or more redirect hops were followed first
depth - the URL's crawl depth
type - the failure category
message - a diagnostic message
statusCode - the HTTP status code, when the failure followed a response
cause - the underlying exception, when the failure originated from one - preserved for explicit diagnostics but excluded from toString() because backend messages may contain sensitive external data
attempts - how many real HTTP requests were made for failedUrl, including the final one. 0 for a CrawlFailureType.CRAWL_LIMIT_REACHED or CrawlFailureType.ALREADY_FETCHED outcome, both of which are always decided before any network call; every other CrawlFailureType always sent at least one real request, so attempts >= 1 - except CrawlFailureType.NETWORK_POLICY_DENIED and CrawlFailureType.NETWORK_POLICY_EVALUATION_FAILED, which can carry either: 0 when the network policy denied the very first attempt (no request for this URL was ever sent), or a positive count when one or more retries of an already-permitted URL succeeded in being sent before a later retry was freshly re-evaluated and denied - every retry is re-authorized immediately before it is sent, so a denial can happen after real attempts already occurred
discoveredFrom - the page this URL was discovered on, absent only for a seed
redirectChain - every redirect hop actually followed before reaching failedUrl; empty when the failure occurred on the first request
public record CrawlFailure(URI requestedUrl, URI failedUrl, int depth, CrawlFailureType type, String message, Optional<Integer> statusCode, Optional<Throwable> cause, int attempts, Optional<URI> discoveredFrom, List<RedirectHop> redirectChain) extends Record
Immutable, structured record of one URL's fetch attempt failing terminally - never a plain null or a silently-dropped entry.

requestedUrl and failedUrl are tracked separately because a redirect chain can fail partway through: for requestedUrl == failedUrl the failure occurred on the very first request, with an empty redirectChain; for A -> B -> C failing on C, requestedUrl is A, failedUrl is C, and redirectChain contains both hops actually followed before the failure - the failure is never reported as if it happened on A alone.
